tool.name: axtSort
tool.description: : sort AXT alignments by target position
tool.command: ## ⚠ In memory: axtSort loads every block before sorting. Right for net-derived AXT (the multiz ## input), wrong for raw lastz output of a whole genome pair. axtSort '$input' '$output'
tool.help:
**What it does**
Sorts AXT blocks by target sequence name (``strcmp``), then target start -- ``axtCmpTarget`` in kent's ``src/lib/axt.c``.
UCSC runs it between ``netToAxt`` and ``axtToMaf`` when building multiz input (``doBlastzChainNet.pl``: ``netToAxt ... | axtSort stdin stdout``). ``netToAxt`` emits blocks in net order, where nested fills follow their parent, so its output is not target-sorted -- and multiz fed unsorted pairwise alignments merges them wrongly with exit status 0.
.. warning:: Every block is held in memory. Use it on net-derived AXT, not raw lastz output.
.. _source code: https://github.com/ucscGenomeBrowser/kent/tree/master/src/hg/mouseStuff/axtSort
